name: Elegoo Centauri Carbon stock toolhead (0.4 mm nozzle, front cowling with 5020 part-cooling fan, X rods)
provenance: Generated from the OpenCentauri community CAD assembly CC_v150.step (https://github.com/OpenCentauri/cad, GPL-3.0; README credits Elegoo for the official X axis and toolhead plastic parts). Frame: nozzle tip at origin, +X right, +Y back, mm. Each Z band of each group is the exact XY bound of the CAD geometry inside that band (tessellation deviation 0.02 mm), split into Y strips. Nozzle tip located at CAD (-160.12, 161.35, 289.02). Checked on a stock printer with calipers: the cowling duct lips (about 3.6 mm left, 3.7 mm right) and the silicone sock (about 4.25 mm) measured within range of these heights above the nozzle tip.
